classifications.rationale: The segment consists solely of prefatory recitals describing the liaison program’s history and a governors’ resolution; it imposes no operative direction or legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: WHEREAS, at a meeting of the Cabinet on February 25, 1965, I designated the Director of the Office of Emergency Planning to serve as liaison with the Governors of the fifty States

classifications.rationale: The President assigns the Director an additional liaison role and title, an internal executive staffing and organizational action without changing legal rights.
classifications.evidence: the Director of the Office of Emergency Planning shall also continue to act as the President's liaison with the Governors of the States and Territories

classifications.rationale: The segment directs executive offices and agencies to provide assistance, cooperation, liaison, and problem-clearing services, all matters of internal coordination and administration.
classifications.evidence: All Federal departments, agencies, and Regional Federal Executive Boards shall continue to extend full cooperation and assistance

classifications.rationale: The segment requires agency heads to designate internal liaison contacts and clarifies that the order does not transfer authority over agencies or their functions; both are internal organizational measures.
classifications.evidence: The head of each Federal department and agency shall designate an appropriate official
